fields.name: Language
fields.description: The language for this meaning. Common choices are English (en) or Hindi (hi). The language determines how the meaning will be displayed to learners.
fields.guidance: Language cannot be changed after creation. If you need a meaning in a different language, create a new meaning instead.

fields.name: Meaning Text
fields.description: The definition or explanation of the lemma. This is what learners will see when they look up the word.
fields.guidance: Write clear, concise definitions. For nouns, describe what the thing is. For verbs, describe the action. Keep definitions practical and learner-friendly. Maximum 1024 characters.

fields.name: Priority
fields.description: The display order for meanings. Lower numbers appear first. If a lemma has multiple meanings, priority determines which one is shown as primary.
fields.guidance: Set the most common or primary meaning to priority 1. Secondary or less common meanings can have higher priority numbers. You can reorder meanings by updating priorities.

actions: Verify the meaning displays correctly in the lemma view
Check that priority ordering is correct relative to other meanings
Ensure linked Usage Sentences still match the updated meaning
